nodes.Rabaul: regional heavy logistics / repair / fuel / air-seaplane hub
nodes.Kavieng: regional support hub; lighter than Rabaul
nodes.Port Moresby: Branch-held land-air ISR/staging hub; not a substitute for Rabaul heavy naval logistics
nodes.Tulagi-Gavutu: usable but limited forward seaplane/anchorage node
nodes.Buka Passage: construction/anchorage node; not a mature fighter base
nodes.Lunga: airfield under construction; ISR/liaison/emergency utility only at cut date, not a mature combat airbase
